description: Template scaffold for defining a new mission type. Copy this file, rename it, fill in every field, and add/remove phase blocks as needed. All numeric fields are placeholders (0 or null) — the simulator should reject a run where required fields are still 0/null except where noted.

phases.phase_name: REPLACE_PHASE_NAME (add as many phase blocks as your mission needs, in order)
phases.notes: Set duration_s to null instead of a number if this phase should run until a reserve floor is hit (see loiter.json for an example).

_field_reference.altitude_m: meters above ground level, start/end of phase
_field_reference.duration_s: seconds; use null for a floor-triggered open-ended phase
_field_reference.power_kw: average shaft/electrical power demand for the phase
_field_reference.speed_mps: airspeed in meters/second, start/end of phase
_field_reference.power_source_hint: which power path the mission simulator should default to before running its own power-split optimization
_field_reference.reserve_floor_behavior: simulation engines should terminate any null-duration phase when fuel_reserve_pct or battery_soc_reserve_pct reaches the value defined in the top-level reserves block
